## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō qīnǚ jīng* (T556) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra by Zhī Qiān 支謙 ([支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99)). Seven women — daughters of a king — debate Buddhist doctrine and demonstrate exceptional bodhisattva-realization, in the same genre as the Candrottarā ([KR6i0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0109)) and other "wise women" texts.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text in the wise-women genre, demonstrating female bodhisattva-capacity. Translation dated to Zhī Qiān's Wú productive period (222–252 CE).
